red_flags.reason: Chest pain can indicate a heart attack or other serious cardiac event. Seek emergency care immediately.
Sudden or severe breathing difficulty may indicate a medical emergency. Call emergency services immediately.
This sounds like a mental health crisis. Please contact a crisis helpline or emergency services immediately.
Severe or uncontrolled bleeding requires immediate emergency care.
These may be signs of a stroke. Call emergency services immediately — time is critical.
This is a life-threatening emergency. Call emergency services immediately.
Severe allergic reactions can be life-threatening. Use an EpiPen if available and call emergency services.
A possible drug overdose is a medical emergency. Call poison control or emergency services immediately.
Seizures may require immediate medical attention, especially if it's a first seizure or lasts more than 5 minutes.
A very high fever can be dangerous and may require urgent medical evaluation.
